param_input_item.param_description: a character vector, a cell array of character vectors, or a string array: names of files or folders to compress. Wildcards '*' and '?' are allowed.
a character vector or string scalar: folder of the .gz files, created if needed.

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of character vectors: names of the written .gz files.

description.p: gzip compresses each file into its own gzip file named after it with '.gz' added.
Without output folder, each .gz file is written next to its file. The original files are kept.
A folder is compressed recursively, file by file.
When no file matches, the error Nelson:gzip:fileNotFound is raised.
Ctrl+C stops the compression and removes the partial .gz file.
